key_insight: Regularized Score Centering stabilizes off-policy reinforcement learning by combining score centering with a reverse-KL penalty that limits drift from the data-generating policy.
engineering_relevance: RSC targets instability from stale rollout data and training–inference numerical mismatch, making it relevant to high-throughput asynchronous training.
method: Use score centering to remove reward-baseline effects from the expected update.
Add reverse-KL regularization to keep learner next-token distributions close to the behavior policy.
Optionally apply truncated importance sampling to cap token importance weights.
evidence_signal: Evaluations span dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks; RSC with TIS leads across six agentic tasks, with a reported 14.3% AppWorld improvement and 9.9× the strongest baseline’s BabyAI score.
watch_item: KL strength and importance-weight truncation require care: excessive constraints may limit learning, while weak constraints may leave harmful policy mismatch.
